Q: SQLDeveloper Trigger Error report - ORA-00942: table or view does not exist A:

Apparently from the comments, you created the table with surrounding quotes, as in

create table "testDSNa" (...)

Without the quotes, all identifiers in Oracle are treated as upper case. Therfore,

create table testDSNa (...)

is treated like

create table "TESTDSNA" (...)

But Oracle's identifiers are case sensitive. For that reasons, if you used surrounding quotes in the create table statement, an the identifier is not all-uppercase, then you must use surrounding quotes in all other usages of that identifier as well.

Q: Case statement with multiple conditions A:

Move the status = 'AC' filter into the CASE expressions and then add your COUNT conditional aggregation:

SELECT manager_name, 
       COUNT(
         CASE WHEN program_code = 'F' AND status = 'AC'
         THEN 1 END
       ) AS f, 
       COUNT(
         CASE WHEN program_code = 'FS' AND  status = 'AC'
         THEN 1 END
       ) AS fs, 
       COUNT(
         CASE WHEN possible_ind='Y' AND  date_attended IS NOT NULL
         AND  status_cd = 'P'
         THEN 1 END
       ) AS fs
FROM   table1
GROUP BY manager_name
-- HAVING COUNT(CASE status WHEN 'AC' THEN 1 END) > 0

You may want to include the final HAVING clause to ensure you don't include groups where there does not exist at least one row where status = 'AC', similar to your original query.

Q: SFTP transfer file and move file to folder A:

sftp client provides a means to change working directory on the host before performing any file transfers. It would be better to thus transfer the file directly to the target location.

NOTE: The above answer was a result of misunderstanding the question. I read it to mean the file had to be moved on the destination but the real operation was to move the file on the origin.

I found the following example code that moves a file after checking that it exists. Wildcards are allowed for the source parameter but then FileExists may not work. Requires vbscript 2.0 to work.

<%
dim filesys
set filesys=CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
If filesys.FileExists("c:\sourcefolder\anyfile.html") Then
   filesys.MoveFile "c:\sourcefolder\anyfile.html", "c:\destfolder\"
End If
%>
